description: JobAZ career route definitions. Public/business knowledge only — no user PII or secrets.

routes.title: Extra Income / Security & Events
routes.description: Practical UK route for people who want extra income or flexible work, often via stewarding and security-related progression. Start with work-now roles, then upgrade with SIA Door Supervisor when ready.
notes: Matchday Steward is a work-now role, not a course.
SIA Door Supervisor is the next upgrade training/licence — not a work-now role.
Never flag 'no published course for Matchday Steward' as a course gap.
Optional add-ons (First Aid, CCTV) are nice to have, not required for a good plan.

routes.title: Care Entry Route
routes.description: Entry route into UK care and support work. Focus on work-now care roles first, then formal care training as the next upgrade.
next_upgrade: Level 2 Diploma in Care or equivalent care training
notes: Prioritise empathy, reliability and safeguarding language on the CV.
Recommend published care training when available; otherwise recommend the course type only.

routes.title: Construction / CSCS Route
routes.description: Practical construction entry route. Work-now site roles first, then CSCS / health and safety training as the next upgrade.
notes: CSCS and Health and Safety in Construction are high-priority next-upgrade training types.
Do not invent providers or claim approved partnerships.

routes.title: Forklift / Warehouse Route
routes.description: Warehouse and logistics route with forklift training as the main upgrade path for better roles and pay progression.
notes: Forklift training is the primary next upgrade.
Emphasise shift availability and safety awareness on the CV.

routes.title: Teaching Assistant / TEFL Route
routes.description: Education support route covering Teaching Assistant pathways and TEFL for language teaching support roles.
notes: Teaching Assistant qualification is commonly recommended; TEFL may be optional or recommended depending on the user's goal.
Safeguarding awareness is important for education settings.

routes.title: Engineering / Education Progression Route
routes.description: Engineering and technical progression route for users with technical backgrounds seeking UK-relevant next steps, membership, or practical certifications.
next_upgrade: UK professional membership or practical certification depending on route
notes: Next upgrade depends on the specific engineering path — do not invent a single mandatory course.
Separate old/test Design Engineer historical sessions from current Extra Income / Security flows when reviewing quality.
Recommend course types and memberships carefully; never invent providers.
